description: In the file finder, an absolute path searches that directory and opens the file. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding local.md; another directory, {{ELSEWHERE}}, holds handoff-notes.md, whose content is "far away content". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open the fuzzy file finder by pressing "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier, without clicking anything first, and wait up to 10s for its input ".grp-filter" to be visible. 3. Fill the finder input with "{{ELSEWHERE}}/handoff". 4. There should come to be exactly 1 ".grp-row" (up to 10s), containing "handoff-notes.md". 5. The list is no longer relative to the working directory, so the finder says where it is looking: ".ff-scope" should contain "{{ELSEWHERE}}". 6. With the finder input focused, press Enter. 7. A dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name contains "Edit {{ELSEWHERE}}/handoff-notes.md" should become visible (up to 15s): Enter opens the file from the re-rooted directory, not a path joined against the conversation's directory. 8. In it, a ".view-line" containing "far away content" should be visible (up to 15s).
